title: Sparkly pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFD54F'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='woodGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#F5DEB3'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#D2B48C'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g transform='rotate(45 50 50)'>
    <!-- pencil body -->
    <rect x='38' y='30' width='24' height='46' rx='2' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
    <!-- body shading stripe -->
    <rect x='38' y='30' width='5' height='46' rx='2' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.8'/>
    <rect x='57' y='30' width='5' height='46' rx='2' fill='#E6A100' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- ferrule / metal band -->
    <rect x='38' y='24' width='24' height='7' rx='1' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
    <rect x='38' y='24' width='5' height='7' fill='#CFD8DC'/>
    <rect x='57' y='24' width='5' height='7' fill='#90A4AE'/>
    <!-- eraser -->
    <rect x='40' y='15' width='20' height='10' rx='4' fill='#EF9A9A'/>
    <rect x='40' y='15' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFCDD2'/>
    <!-- wood tip -->
    <polygon points='38,76 62,76 50,88' fill='url(#woodGrad)'/>
    <!-- graphite tip -->
    <polygon points='46,83 54,83 50,89' fill='#546E7A'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFEB3B'>
    <polygon points='22,20 24,26 30,28 24,30 22,36 20,30 14,28 20,26'/>
    <polygon points='78,22 79.5,26.5 84,28 79.5,29.5 78,34 76.5,29.5 72,28 76.5,26.5'/>
    <polygon points='76,72 77.5,76.5 82,78 77.5,79.5 76,84 74.5,79.5 70,78 74.5,76.5'/>
    <polygon points='20,70 21.5,74.5 26,76 21.5,77.5 20,82 18.5,77.5 14,76 18.5,74.5'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <polygon points='50,10 51,14 55,15 51,16 50,20 49,16 45,15 49,14'/>
    <polygon points='86,50 87,54 91,55 87,56 86,60 85,56 81,55 85,54'/>
    <polygon points='12,44 13,48 17,49 13,50 12,54 11,50 7,49 11,48'/>
    <polygon points='44,90 45,93 48,94 45,95 44,98 43,95 40,94 43,93'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#B2EBF2'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='94' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='88' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
